items.name: The blood pressure reflex slows down
It settles within a minute or two
Fainting or a fall injury is a sign

closing.headline: Dizziness every time you stand isn't just ordinary aging.
closing.tip: Sit on the edge of the bed or chair for a moment before standing up slowly.
closing.cta: If you've actually fainted or been hurt in a fall, get checked with a doctor.
